supersedes: website-changes-review.html for the items revised in this document

changes.result: Removed the blanket gradient treatment. The footer title is white again, with its original cyan punctuation.

changes.request: Remove the planning panel wherever it appears
changes.result: Removed the “Plan your next step” resource panel from all parent and specialist service pages.

changes.request: Improve the Services directory and reduce text size slightly
changes.result: Reduced group headings to 22–28px and service-card titles to 17px, with natural wrapping. Other pages retain their existing font sizes.

changes.request: Remove breadcrumb navigation from every page
changes.result: Removed the shared breadcrumb component and its styling. No rendered breadcrumb navigation remains on any of the 84 routes.
Removed the mobile directory pause button. Continuous scrolling and reduced-motion behavior remain; the tablet and desktop carousel is unchanged.
Removed the mobile testimonial pause button. The existing review cards and carousel behavior remain.

changes.request: Restore original heading text colors throughout the site
changes.result: Removed the newly added site-wide gradient override so each section uses its original theme colors. Existing font sizes, typography, section themes and layout fixes are retained except for the requested Services directory size adjustment.

validation.scope: Local Chrome checks with fixed-width viewports and representative light/dark screenshots. The local SEO checklist does not measure organic traffic or rankings.
